about.title: Building Houston's steel since 1997
text: Since 1997 we have been providing high quality services to the city of Houston and surrounding cities. Over the years we have erected commercial and industrial buildings for major corporations and clients, including Ford, Starbucks, Popeye's and Hilton.

We work together with our clients from start to finish, and we are always up to date on code changes in Texas and abroad. We use high grade products and steel that meets or exceeds local codes, including USA sourced structural steel.
We are also a welding and fabricating shop. We are located in Houston and will travel if needed, and if you are in the area you can swing by the shop.

steps.title: Meet and collaborate
steps.text: Meet with our design and construction team to plan your new metal building. Our design-build team then delivers preliminary drawings and estimates.

steps.title: Fabricate the steel
steps.text: Once the drawings are approved, it's time to fabricate your steel building.

steps.title: Prepare the site
steps.text: Ground and site prep, including preparing the foundation slab.

steps.title: Frame, sheet and deliver
steps.text: We install the beams, then the wall panels, then the trim and accessories: doors, windows, skylights, vents and fans. Your building is delivered as designed.

facts.heading: Clients We Have Built For
facts.text: We have erected buildings for major corporations, like Ford, Starbucks, Popeye's and Hilton, to name a few. Our projects include the 900 Westmon Shopping Center.

facts.heading: Why Steel Buildings
facts.text: PEMB and structural steel buildings are affordable, durable and energy efficient. They are designed to withstand 100 to 160 mph sustained winds, come with a water resistant coating against rust, are safe from termites and other frame damaging pests, and are fire resistant in nature.

facts.heading: Free Building Estimate
facts.text: Fill out our free estimate form or call (713) 771-6500. The form asks whether you are a contractor, the size of your PEMB (width, length and height), the building use, the zip code of the install, your time frame (from ASAP to more than a year), commercial or residential delivery, whether you have financing for the building, and your project.

facts.heading: Careers
facts.text: M&M's Welding and Fabricating is an equal opportunity employer with a safe and drug free work environment. We have openings for fitters, welders, painters, PM and general labor. Apply online, or download the application in English or Spanish and drop it off at our office at 12959 Fondren Rd, Houston, TX 77035.
